visual_findings.photo: Fine parachute cords remain absent, fine cloud/building detail soft. No clear native gain over matched V60.
visual_findings.paired: Strong smoothing of plate/edge and brown-field regions. AHD is an independently demosaiced registered reference, not exact RGBGT.
visual_findings.analytic: Dark carrier nearly absent; period16 weak carrier attenuated, saved in-phase gain.44277 versus V60.52060 and ideal1.
visual_findings.GFX: Quiet sky; soft truss, foliage and fence crossings. No clear gain over V60. Different aperture/focus/motion in independentISO100 reference prevent attributing every visual difference to denoising.
visual_findings.other_cameras: Q2 rocks and Sony fuselage soft. GFX50R retains more wall texture than RawNIND but also grain; no broad superiority.
visual_findings.CPU_colors: Neutral smooth; warm field varies; cyclicmagenta substantially mottled; cyan smooth.
visual_findings.CUDA_grid: Fixed gray/warm close; magenta remains biased/mottled. Mean bright highsat bias drops but worst is still.103; diagnostic is not a blind photo benchmark.
